reason: It hits my exact pain and the guarantee being on a metric they control is smart, but I've been burned by coaches and agencies before and I default to thinking I can fix the pitch myself. I still can't separate 'the sprint worked' from 'we got lucky with the product or the buyer'.
objection: How do I know a better advance rate came from this sprint and not from a better month, a warmer pipeline, or our product maturing? Small sample, no control, easy to fool yourself.
would_change_my_mind: Documented before/after from 2-3 founders in AI/logistics/supply chain I can actually call, showing the advance-rate lift held across enough demos that it isn't noise.
